floorReceiving.basis: Proposed independent cabinet gravity plinth onto the actual structural floor through sleeved finish interruptions; no strength or dry-side DPC capacity is supplied by a finish datum.

operating.ordinaryInsideIsolation: Each house branch retains its own reachable ordinary indoor stopvalve. Opening a known wet/faulted compartment requires independent Lodge isolation first; no live-fault-open containment is claimed.
coldSequence: Close both independent Lodge cuts; exclude electricity, drain and prove zero pressure. Move washer to its restrained first rest before a wall-tube draw.
Remove the four independent front panels. Independently retain the actual upper network before loosening its first source-bound overhead connection and the separate pipe clamp.
Use two39mm spanners; withdraw the released upper plain riser27mm from the lower valve compression socket before removing it forward. Do not claim zero retreat or a reusable damaged olive.
Remove the valve and separate lower dogleg tubes after releasing their ordinary compression nuts. Withdraw the now-straight wall tube by the computed travel, with separate wall wet closures opened.
Restore the pressure fittings, static bulkheads, independent pans/returns, all protective boundaries and electrical field; pressure/leak and fitted fault/spray checks precede charging.

branches.pipeStockScope: Copper stock uses maximum OD/maximum wall; contained water and pA use maximum OD/minimum wall as independent adverse bounds. Nominal tube flexibility remains the declared comparative law; no tolerance-corner thermal/fitting certificate. Known service gaps deducted from the tube-only centreline; upper1degree arc chords carry their stated approximation. Cast fitting/valve stiffness and final bought-part masses remain separate.

componentTakeoff.upperShapedTubeAndConnections: Upper path is a source-bound tube-only flexibility route; actual formed/fitting schedule and joint stiffness remain unresolved.

thermal.method: Same upper/lower3D tube-flexibility kernels, joined by exact Simpson receiver strain-energy integrals and all physical fixed/guide lever moments. One14-redundant compatible solve; independently signed segment temperatures retained. Fixed-base post, rigid arms and source six-axis endpoint laws are explicit comparison assumptions.
